backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Theiarco backend, implementing CRUD operations for user profiles, publishers, pioneers, territories, shepherding visits, service meeting conductors, field service groups, tasks, and notes, with role-based access control via a MixinAuthorization mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing three PDF export utility rewrites (pioneers, tasks, notes) to use jsPDF with built-in fonts, no external resources, and synchronous save() downloads.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, used as a build-planning reference for the React frontend.
frontend/.env: Sets the Internet Identity provider URL to https://identity.ic0.app for frontend authentication.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based design token variables for light and dark modes, including colors for backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Theiarco React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that handles authentication state and defines all TanStack Router routes for the app, including publishers, pioneers, territories, shepherding, conductors, field service groups, tasks, notes, and user profile pages.
frontend/src/components/conductors/Condu: Modal dialog for creating or editing a TrainedServiceMeetingConductor, with fields for publisher selection, training date, availability by day of week, status, and notes.
frontend/src/components/conductors/Delet: Alert dialog component for confirming deletion of a trained conductor record, using the useDeleteTrainedConductor mutation hook with a loading state during deletion.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Att: Display card showing attendance statistics including total publishers, mid-week average, and weekend average as percentage progress bars with a group color.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Del: Alert dialog for confirming permanent deletion of a meeting attendance record, using the useDeleteMeetingAttendance mutation hook.
Alert dialog for confirming deletion of a group visit record, using the useDeleteGroupVisit mutation hook with toast notifications for success and error.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Gro: Card component displaying a group visit's details including date, discussion topics, publishers present, and notes, with optional edit and delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Rec: Modal dialog for creating or editing a meeting attendance record, allowing selection of date, meeting type, and which publishers were present.
Modal dialog for creating or editing a group visit record, with fields for visit date, discussion topics, publishers present, notes, and next planned visit date.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root application layout component composing the sidebar, header, main content outlet, toast notifications, and a global reconnect toast manager.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Top navigation header displaying the app title, a mobile menu toggle button, and a logout button that clears the identity and React Query cache.
frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.t: Renders a responsive sidebar navigation component with themed active/hover states for each route, supporting mobile overlay toggle and desktop static display.
frontend/src/components/notes/AddGlobalN: Modal dialog for creating or editing a global note with fields for title, content, category, and optional publisher attachment, using create/update mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/notes/GlobalNote: Displays a single global note as a card with title, category badge, content preview, attached publisher, creation date, and edit/delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/AddPion: Modal dialog for entering and submitting monthly pioneer service hours for a specific pioneer, month, and service year.
Modal dialog for adding a new pioneer record by selecting an active publisher and a service year, using the create pioneer mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/Current: Displays a badge indicating a pioneer's tracking status (On Track, Behind, or No Entries) based on their average monthly hours for a given service year.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/DeleteP: Confirmation alert dialog for deleting a pioneer record, invoking the delete mutation and showing success or error toasts on completion.
Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a specific pioneer monthly hours record, with loading state handling during deletion.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/EditPio: A modal dialog for editing a pioneer's monthly hours record, with a numeric input pre-filled from the existing record and a mutation to save the update.
A modal dialog for editing a pioneer's publisher assignment and service year, using a dropdown of active publishers and calling an update mutation on submit.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/Pioneer: A card component that displays a pioneer's total hours, service year average, and a status badge (loading, no-entries, on-track, or behind).
A table row component for a single pioneer that fetches and displays their total hours, average hours, current status badge, and edit/delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/publicWitnessing: An alert dialog that confirms and executes deletion of a trained publisher record via a delete mutation.
A modal form for creating or editing a trained publisher, handling publisher selection, training date, authorization status, and S-148 receipt, then calling the appropriate create or update mutation.
frontend/src/components/publishers/AddPu: A modal form for adding a new publisher with fields for name, field service group, privileges, and role checkboxes, submitting via an add publisher mutation.
frontend/src/components/publishers/Delet: File content was not provided; likely a confirmation dialog for deleting a publisher note.
frontend/src/components/publishers/EditP: A modal dialog for editing an existing publisher's details including name, field service group, privileges, and active status. Initializes form state from the provided publisher prop and submits updates via the useUpdatePublisher hook.
frontend/src/components/shepherding/Edit: A modal dialog for editing an existing shepherding visit, allowing updates to publisher, visit date, and elders present fields. Initializes form from the provided visit prop and submits changes via the useUpdateShepherdingVisit hook.
frontend/src/components/shepherding/Reco: A modal dialog for recording a new shepherding visit with fields for publisher, visit date, elders present, and notes. Resets form on close and submits data via the useCreateShepherdingVisit hook.
frontend/src/components/system/Reconnect: A renderless component that monitors in-flight queries, mutations, and actor availability to display a persistent 'Reconnecting…' toast when the connection is unavailable, then shows a success toast when restored.
frontend/src/components/tasks/AddTaskMod: A modal dialog for creating a new task with title, due date, category, and optional notes fields. Submits the new task via the useCreateTask hook and resets the form on close.
frontend/src/components/tasks/EditTaskMo: A modal dialog for editing an existing task's title, due date, category, and notes. Initializes form state from the provided task prop and submits updates via the useUpdateTask hook.
frontend/src/components/territories/AddT: Modal dialog for creating a new territory with fields for territory number/name and type, including validation and success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/territories/Chec: Table component displaying a territory's checkout history sorted by date descending, with optional edit and delete action buttons per row.
Modal dialog for checking out a territory to a publisher, with fields for publisher selection, checkout date, and campaign flag.
frontend/src/components/territories/Dele: Confirmation alert dialog for deleting a specific checkout record, calling the delete mutation and showing a toast on success or failure.
Confirmation alert dialog for deleting a territory note, calling the delete mutation and showing a toast on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/territories/Edit: Modal dialog for editing an existing checkout record, pre-filling publisher, dates, and campaign flag, then submitting updates via mutation.
Modal dialog for editing an existing territory's number and type, pre-filling current values and submitting updates via mutation with validation.
Modal dialog for editing an existing territory note, using a textarea and the useUpdateTerritoryNote hook to save changes with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/territories/Terr: Card component that displays a single territory note's content and creation date with edit and delete action buttons.
Section component for a territory's notes page that handles creating, listing, editing, and deleting notes using a textarea composer and child modal/dialog components.
frontend/src/components/theming/ThemedPr: A forwarded-ref Button wrapper that applies a theme color as background and automatically selects a contrasting text color.
frontend/src/components/theming/ThemedTa: Exports a themed table header row and header cell component that apply a theme background/text color with automatic contrast calculation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddMeetingAttendan: Mutation hook that records meeting attendance by calling the backend actor with group, date, type, and publisher data, then invalidates the meetingAttendance query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddPublisher.ts: Mutation hook that adds a new publisher to the backend by mapping UI privilege options to backend objects and invalidating the publishers query cache on success.
Provides hooks to fetch the current caller's user profile and to save/update it, both dependent on the actor being available.
Mutation hook that checks out a territory to a publisher by calling the backend actor with a normalized epoch-seconds date, then invalidates territory-related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateGlobalNote.t: Mutation hook that creates a global note with title, content, category, and optional publisher attachment, invalidating globalNotes queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateGroupVisit.t: Mutation hook that submits a new group visit record to the backend and invalidates the relevant groupVisits query cache entries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreatePioneer.ts: Mutation hook that creates a new pioneer record via the backend actor and invalidates the pioneers query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateShepherdingV: Mutation hook that creates a shepherding visit record via the backend actor and invalidates the shepherdingVisits query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTask.ts: Mutation hook that creates a new task with title, due date, category, and optional notes via the backend actor, then invalidates all task queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTerritory.ts: Mutation hook that creates a new territory with a generated unique ID, number, and type via the backend actor, then invalidates the territories query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTrainedCondu: React Query mutation hook that calls `addTrainedConductor` on the actor and invalidates the `trainedConductors` cache on success, showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTrainedPubli: React Query mutation hook that creates a trained publisher via `addTrainedPublisher` and optionally sets S-148 status, invalidating the `trainedPublishers` cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCheckoutReco: React Query mutation hook that deletes a territory checkout record by territoryId, publisherId, and date, then invalidates related territory queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteGlobalNote.t: React Query mutation hook that deletes a global note by ID and invalidates the `globalNotes` cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteGroupVisit.t: React Query mutation hook that deletes a group visit by visitId and invalidates/removes related group visit cache entries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteMeetingAtten: React Query mutation hook that deletes a meeting attendance record by ID, invalidates `meetingAttendance` queries, and shows toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeletePioneer.ts: React Query mutation hook that deletes a pioneer by ID, invalidates the pioneers list, and removes the individual pioneer cache entry.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeletePublisher.ts: React Query mutation hook that deletes a publisher with optimistic UI update, rolling back on error and invalidating the `publishers` cache on settle.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTask.ts: React Query mutation hook that deletes a task by bigint ID and invalidates all `tasks` queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTrainedCondu: React Query mutation hook that deletes a trained conductor by ID, invalidates `trainedConductors` cache, and shows toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTrainedPubli: React Query mutation hook that deletes a trained publisher by ID, invalidates `trainedPublishers` cache, and shows toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useGlobalNotes.ts: Exports two React Query hooks: `useGetAllGlobalNotes` for fetching all global notes and `useGetGlobalNote` for fetching a single note by bigint ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useGroupVisit.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single group visit by visitId from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGroupVisits.ts: React Query hook that fetches all group visits for a given group ID, guarding against invalid group IDs.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook that manage DFINITY AuthClient login/logout state and expose identity and status flags.
React Query hook that fetches meeting attendance records, optionally filtered by group number, from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneerHours.ts: Exports multiple React Query hooks and mutations for fetching, adding, updating, and deleting pioneer monthly hours records.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneers.ts: Exports two React Query hooks: `useGetAllPioneers` for fetching all pioneers and `useGetPioneer` for fetching a single pioneer by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneersOnTrack.ts: React Query hook that calculates how many pioneers are averaging 50 or more hours per month for a given service year.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublisherNotes.ts: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports two React Query hooks: `useGetAllPublishers` for fetching all publishers and `useGetPublisher` for fetching a single publisher by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceMeetingCond: React Query hook that fetches all Service Meeting Conductor assignments from the backend actor, disabled until the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useShepherdingVisit.t: React Query hooks for fetching a single shepherding visit by ID, updating a visit's full data or just its notes, and deleting a visit, with cache invalidation on mutations.
React Query hook that fetches all shepherding visits from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTasks.ts: React Query hooks for fetching a filtered list of tasks by status and a single task by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritories.ts: React Query hook that fetches all territories from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritory.ts: React Query hooks for fetching a single territory by ID, and mutations for updating, deleting, marking as returned, and making a territory available, with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritoryNotes.ts: React Query hooks for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes associated with a specific territory, with cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTrainedConductor.t: React Query hooks for fetching a single trained conductor by ID, updating only its notes field, and deleting it, with cache invalidation.
React Query hook that fetches all trained Service Meeting Conductors from the backend actor.
React Query hook that fetches all trained publishers from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCheckoutReco: Mutation hook that updates a territory checkout record, normalizing timestamps to epoch seconds before sending to the backend and invalidating territory caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateGlobalNote.t: Mutation hook that updates a global note's title, content, category, and optional attached publisher, invalidating the global notes cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateGroupVisit.t: Mutation hook that updates a group visit record with full field data and invalidates related group visit queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateMeetingAtten: Mutation hook that updates a meeting attendance record, converting the meeting date to epoch seconds, with toast notifications and cache invalidation on success or error.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdatePioneer.ts: Mutation hook that edits a pioneer record by ID and invalidates both the pioneers list and the individual pioneer cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdatePublisher.ts: Mutation hook that updates a publisher's details, mapping UI privilege strings to backend privilege objects, and invalidates the publishers list cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTask.ts: Mutation hook that updates a task by ID with a new input payload and invalidates all task queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTaskCompleti: Mutation hook that toggles a task's completion status by ID and invalidates all task queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTrainedCondu: React Query mutation hook for updating a trained conductor, invalidating related queries and showing a success toast on completion.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTrainedPubli: React Query mutation hook for updating a trained publisher's details and S-148 status via two separate actor calls, with success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark theme colors including custom Theiarco brand and dashboard stat card colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/ComingSoon.tsx: Simple placeholder page component that displays a 'Coming Soon' message with a construction icon and a configurable title.
frontend/src/pages/ConductorProfile.tsx: Detail page for a single trained conductor showing their info, editable notes, and options to edit or delete the conductor with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page that aggregates and displays stats for publishers, territories, tasks, shepherding visits, pioneers on track, meeting attendance, and global notes.
frontend/src/pages/FieldServiceGroupProf: Detail page for a specific field service group showing its publishers, group visits, and meeting attendance records with modals for recording and editing entries.
frontend/src/pages/FieldServiceGroups.ts: Page listing all four field service groups as clickable cards, each showing the group's overseer, assistant, and active publishers.
frontend/src/pages/GroupVisitProfile.tsx: Displays a detailed profile page for a single group visit, showing attendees, discussion topics, and notes, with options to edit or delete the visit via modals/dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Renders the login page for the Theiarco app, providing an Internet Identity authentication button with loading state.
frontend/src/pages/Notes.tsx: Displays a filterable list of global notes by category with options to add, edit, delete, and export notes to PDF.
frontend/src/pages/PioneerProfile.tsx: Shows a detailed profile for an individual pioneer including monthly hours tracking with inline editing, statistics, and options to add, edit, or delete hours records and the pioneer itself.
frontend/src/pages/Pioneers.tsx: Lists all pioneers in a table with actions to add, edit, delete, navigate to profiles, and export data to CSV or PDF.
frontend/src/pages/PublicWitnessing.tsx: Displays a sorted table of trained public witnessing publishers with authorization status and S-148 form info, supporting add, edit, and delete operations.
frontend/src/pages/PublisherProfile.tsx: Displays a detailed profile page for a single publisher, showing their attributes and badges, with options to edit or delete the publisher via a modal and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Publishers.tsx: Renders a filterable, sortable table of all publishers with search, group, and active-status filters, plus add/edit/delete actions via modals and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ServiceMeetingConduct: Displays a sorted table of trained service meeting conductors with add, edit, and delete capabilities, using themed table headers and navigation to individual conductor profiles.
frontend/src/pages/Shepherding.tsx: Shows a searchable, date-sorted list of shepherding visits with options to record new visits, edit existing ones, and delete them via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/ShepherdingVisitProfi: Renders a detail view for a single shepherding visit, allowing inline editing of notes with save/cancel, plus edit and delete actions via modal and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Tasks.tsx: Tasks page component that displays a filterable, sortable table of tasks with support for adding, editing, deleting, toggling completion, and exporting tasks to CSV or PDF.
frontend/src/pages/Territories.tsx: Territories page component that lists all territories in a sortable table with actions for adding, editing, deleting, and exporting territory assignment records to CSV.
frontend/src/pages/TerritoryProfile.tsx: Detail page for a single territory showing its status, checkout history, and notes, with modals for editing, checking out, and managing checkout records.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfile.tsx: User profile page allowing the current user to view and inline-edit their full name and congregation name with save/cancel controls.
frontend/src/theme/colorUtils.ts: Utility functions for color manipulation including hex-to-RGB parsing, WCAG luminance calculation, contrast color selection (black or white), and color lightening.
frontend/src/theme/pageTheme.ts: Defines a centralized mapping of page route paths to theme hex colors and exports helper functions to look up the theme color for a given path.
frontend/src/utils/fieldServiceGroupColo: Defines a color mapping for field service groups 1–4 and exports a helper function to retrieve a group's color by number.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Collection of date-formatting utilities that convert backend bigint timestamps (in nanoseconds or seconds) to human-readable 'MMM d, yyyy' strings for notes, tasks, checkouts, visits, weeks, and training dates.
frontend/src/utils/groupVisitNotes.ts: Parses a combined notes string (created by RecordGroupVisitModal) into structured fields: discussionTopics, overseerNotes, assistantNotes, and nextPlannedVisitDate using regex section matching.
frontend/src/utils/meetingAttendanceStat: Provides utility functions to calculate and format meeting attendance statistics, including active publisher counts, average attendance by meeting type, percentages, and an overview across all groups.
frontend/src/utils/notesPdfExport.ts: Generates an HTML-based notes report grouped by category and triggers a direct browser download as a file, without opening a new window.
frontend/src/utils/pioneersCsvExport.ts: Builds and downloads a CSV export of pioneer service hour data, organized by service-year months (September–August), with helpers for headers, field escaping, and browser download triggering.
frontend/src/utils/pioneersPdfExport.ts: Generates an HTML-based pioneers report table with monthly hours and status styling, then triggers a direct browser download as an HTML file intended for print/PDF.
frontend/src/utils/privilegeBadges.ts: Returns Tailwind CSS class strings for privilege badge styling, mapping 'Elder' to purple and 'Ministerial Servant' to blue.
frontend/src/utils/reconnectState.ts: Implements a singleton observable state class that tracks whether an 'Actor not available' error is active and notifies subscribed listeners on changes.
frontend/src/utils/serviceYear.ts: Calculates and returns the current JW service year (September–August) as a 'YYYY-YYYY' string based on today's date.
frontend/src/utils/tasksCsvExport.ts: Builds and downloads a CSV export of task data (title, due date, category, status, notes) with proper field escaping and browser download triggering.
frontend/src/utils/tasksPdfExport.ts: Generates an HTML-based tasks report table with status styling and triggers a direct browser download as an HTML file intended for print/PDF.
frontend/src/utils/territoryAssignmentRe: Builds and downloads a CSV file in S-13-E Territory Assignment Record format, including territory number, last completion date, and the 4 most recent checkout records per territory.
frontend/src/utils/territoryTime.ts: Provides utility functions for normalizing backend timestamps (handling nanoseconds, milliseconds, and seconds) and calculating checkout durations in days or months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and hash cleanup helpers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for a fix request focused on rewriting PDF export utilities (pioneers, tasks, notes) to use jsPDF with built-in fonts only, no external resources, and synchronous downloads.
